北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，有霾且体感寒冷，请注意防护和保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's hazy and feels cold. Please protect yourself and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天有风，体感较凉，记得添衣保暖，别着凉了。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, feeling cool. Remember to add clothes and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感仅 3℃，出行多穿点，注意防寒哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is gloomy and cold, feels like only 3℃. Dress warmly when going out, stay protected from the cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温舒适，但早晚温差大，别忘添减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Mind the morning-evening temperature difference, remember to adjust your clothing.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感凉爽，湿度较高，保持心情舒畅哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels cool, with high humidity. Keep a cheerful mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感寒凉，注意保暖，别让湿冷侵袭。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels cold. Stay warm and protect yourself from the damp chill.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京气温 5℃，体感 1℃，天冷多穿，别冻着了。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is 5℃, feels like 1℃. Dress warmly, don't catch a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度大，体感有点凉，注意防潮和保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and humid, feels a bit cool. Pay attention to moisture and staying warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾且体感 0℃，能见度低，出行慢点，注意安全保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and feels like 0℃. Visibility is low, drive slowly, and stay safe and warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗但体感凉，风干物燥，记得多喝水，注意保湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels cool. It's dry, so remember to drink more water and moisturize.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 6℃，注意添衣保暖，别感冒了。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 6℃. Remember to add clothes and stay warm to avoid catching a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大霾极寒，体感 -14℃！请务必全副武装，注意防寒保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has heavy haze and extreme cold, feels like -14℃! Please bundle up completely, pay close attention to keeping warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -5℃，出行注意防寒，多穿衣物哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is gloomy and cold, feels like -5℃. Pay attention to cold protection when going out, wear more clothes.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感舒适，记得享受好天气，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has perfect sunshine and feels comfortable. Remember to enjoy the good weather and protect yourself from the sun.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感偏凉，记得带件外套，别着凉了。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to bring a jacket, don't catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷有风，体感 -3℃，注意防风保暖，别感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is gloomy and cold with wind, feels like -3℃. Pay attention to wind and cold protection, don't catch a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 -3℃，记得穿暖和点，小心着凉哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -3℃. Remember to dress warmly, watch out for catching a cold.
